meta.title: Frequently asked questions — Mobilcab
meta.description: Straight answers about Mobilcab: installing, tablets, CNC export, pricing, the Basic plan, and how far you can rely on the AI assistant.

hero.label: Frequently asked questions
hero.title: Straight answers, before you sign up.
hero.body: If you can't find what you're looking for, write to us. We answer personally.

items.q: Do I need to install anything?
a: No. Mobilcab runs straight from your browser, on laptop, tablet or phone. Nothing to install, no license server.

items.q: Does it work on a tablet?
a: Yes, it's built for laptop, tablet and phone. You can start a project in the workshop and show it to your client on a tablet, on-site.

items.q: Can I export directly for my CNC?
a: The cut list (dimensions, quantities, materials) is the workshop foundation.
Dedicated CNC machine export comes in a later roadmap stage — after nesting is solid. It is not included in Basic at paid launch.
The app is free for now and we are not charging subscriptions. If you want a discount on Basic, join the Founding Partner waitlist.

When we ship M2 and open paid Basic (design, cut lists, nesting, labels, quotes), people on the FP waitlist get a discount versus list price. Anyone who subscribes later, without a waitlist place, pays full list. You are not obliged to pay if you do not want to. AI and CNC plans will be announced separately.

items.q: Is the AI assistant's output guaranteed to be accurate?
a: No. The AI assistant is a helper, not a guarantee. It flags possible problems — for example, a drawer that would hit a hinge — and suggests panel splits, but it can be wrong.
Always verify dimensions, clearances and the cutlist before cutting. The final call is yours.

items.q: How is Basic different from the other plans?
a: At paid launch with M2, Basic is the workshop plan: 3D design, cut list, sheet nesting, labels and client quotes — no CNC and no recurring AI. Founding Partners on the waitlist: discount; later: list price.
Starter, Pro and Studio (later) add the AI assistant, with more requests per month at each step. The figures below are indicative until we open payment:
